note.modeMonitor: Report only (don't delete) mode: automod only posts review cards; nothing is deleted or punished until you apply it. Rules with their own mode (`/automod rule`) keep it.
note.modeEnforce: Enforce mode: automod deletes and punishes automatically and posts a review card for every decision. Rules with their own mode (`/automod rule`) keep it.

note.channelDefault: **{label}** in <#{channelId}> follows the rule's normal mode again.
note.categorySet: **{label}** is **{mode}** in <#{channelId}> and the channels in it (threads included).
note.friendlyOn: Friendly notice for a first small offence is **on**: a member's first offence in 30 days on caps, characters, English only or mild language (no slurs) gets a short notice instead of a warning.
note.friendlyOff: Friendly notice for a first small offence is **off**: every offence gets the usual punishment.
note.moodOn: Mood alerts are **on**: when insults or caps floods from 3+ members pile up in a channel, the bot posts one calm-down note, turns on slowmode for a few minutes and tells the alerts channel.
note.panicOn: Raid panic mode is **on**: when a join raid starts a lockdown, invites and DMs are paused for **{hours} h** (lifted again by `/automod lockdown-end`).
note.panicNoPerm: I don't have **Manage Server**, so the pause will fail until I get it.
note.panicOff: Raid panic mode is **off**: a lockdown only raises the verification level.
note.guardAlways: The staff guard is always on in this server.
note.guardOn: Staff guard is **on**{notYet}: an admin who mass-bans, mass-kicks or mass-deletes channels or roles loses their staff roles, and a bot added by a non-owner is kicked. The server owner is never affected. I keep a daily snapshot of the channels and roles, so a nuke alert can show what changed and revert it.
note.guardNotYet: (it starts working once automod is on: `/automod enable`)
note.guardNoPerm: I need **Manage Roles** and **View Audit Log** for it to work.
note.noLockdown: There is no lockdown right now.
note.lockdownEnded: Lockdown ended. The verification level is back to what it was, and paused invites and DMs are resumed.
note.startedMonitor: **Report only:** Mewvo posts a review card with an Apply button and deletes nothing. Switch to On (`/automod mode`) when the cards look right.
